{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792993734737,"sessionID":"ses_e893fd3dfffeWSgr5r4RTpxwo0","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01UG7Joo5EPVTG9n1TehjmAC","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r2/nbody/nbody.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nstatic_assert(sizeof(Body) == 6 * sizeof(double), \"Body must be packed as six doubles\");\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes the force accumulators for B consecutive bodies starting at index i0.\n// Each body's sum is accumulated over j = 0..n-1 in increasing order, exactly as in the\n// serial reference, so results are bit-identical regardless of how bodies are distributed.\n// Processing B bodies per pass lets the compiler vectorize across bodies (not across j,\n// which would reorder the floating-point reduction).\ntemplate <size_t B>\nstatic inline void forceBlock(const double* __restrict px, const double* __restrict py,\n                              const double* __restrict pz, size_t n, size_t i0,\n                              double* __restrict Fx, double* __restrict Fy, double* __restrict Fz) {\n    double xi[B], yi[B], zi[B];\n    double fx[B], fy[B], fz[B];\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        xi[k] = px[i0 + k];\n        yi[k] = py[i0 + k];\n        zi[k] = pz[i0 + k];\n        fx[k] = 0.0;\n        fy[k] = 0.0;\n        fz[k] = 0.0;\n    }\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const double xj = px[j];\n        const double yj = py[j];\n        const double zj = pz[j];\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n            const double dx = xj - xi[k];\n            const double dy = yj - yi[k];\n            const double dz = zj - zi[k];\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            fx[k] += dx * invDist3;\n            fy[k] += dy * invDist3;\n            fz[k] += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < B; ++k) {\n        Fx[k] = fx[k];\n        Fy[k] = fy[k];\n        Fz[k] = fz[k];\n    }\n}\n\n// Updates velocities of bodies in [first, first + count) using the positions of all bodies.\n// bodies must hold the globally consistent state at the start of the step.\nvoid computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, size_t first, size_t count,\n                   const std::vector<double>& px, const std::vector<double>& py,\n                   const std::vector<double>& pz) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    constexpr size_t BLOCK = 8;\n    double Fx[BLOCK], Fy[BLOCK], Fz[BLOCK];\n\n    size_t local = 0;\n    while (local < count) {\n        const size_t i0 = first + local;\n        if (count - local >= BLOCK) {\n            forceBlock<BLOCK>(px.data(), py.data(), pz.data(), n, i0, Fx, Fy, Fz);\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < BLOCK; ++k) {\n                Body& b = bodies[i0 + k];\n                b.vel.x += DT * Fx[k];\n                b.vel.y += DT * Fy[k];\n                b.vel.z += DT * Fz[k];\n            }\n            local += BLOCK;\n        } else {\n            forceBlock<1>(px.data(), py.data(), pz.data(), n, i0, Fx, Fy, Fz);\n            Body& b = bodies[i0];\n            b.vel.x += DT * Fx[0];\n            b.vel.y += DT * Fy[0];\n            b.vel.z += DT * Fz[0];\n            local += 1;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, size_t first, size_t count) {\n    for (size_t i = first; i < first + count; ++i) {\n        Body& body = bodies[i];\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                         body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                         body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, bool report) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            if (report) printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            if (report) printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            if (report) printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Contiguous block partition of n items over `size` ranks.\nvoid blockPartition(size_t n, int size, std::vector<int>& counts, std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    counts.assign(size, 0);\n    displs.assign(size, 0);\n    const size_t base = n / size;\n    const size_t rem = n % size;\n    size_t offset = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t c = base + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(offset);\n        offset += c;\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies < 0) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Number of bodies must be non-negative\\n\");\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Every rank holds the full, globally consistent body state. Initialization is\n    // deterministic, so all ranks generate identical data without communication.\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of bodies whose forces/velocities it computes.\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n    blockPartition(static_cast<size_t>(numBodies), size, counts, displs);\n    const size_t first = static_cast<size_t>(displs[rank]);\n    const size_t count = static_cast<size_t>(counts[rank]);\n\n    // Element-count arrays for exchanging full Body state (6 doubles per body).\n    std::vector<int> dcounts(size), ddispls(size);\n    for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n        dcounts[r] = counts[r] * 6;\n        ddispls[r] = displs[r] * 6;\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> px(numBodies), py(numBodies), pz(numBodies);\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        // Gather a structure-of-arrays copy of positions for vectorizable inner loops.\n        for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {\n            px[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;\n            py[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;\n            pz[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;\n        }\n\n        computeForces(bodies, first, count, px, py, pz);\n        integrateBodies(bodies, first, count);\n\n        // Share updated state of every rank's block with all ranks.\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL,\n                       bodies.data(), dcounts.data(), ddispls.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * 6);\n        for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n    // The state is identical on all ranks, so every rank reaches the same verdict.\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n\n        if (validateSimulation(bodies, root)) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            if (root) {\n                double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1792994847796,"sessionID":"ses_e893fd3dfffeWSgr5r4RTpxwo0","part":{"id":"prt_176d2150e001ftNuA3IoMvdxkY","messageID":"msg_176d20b80001W770cZV8AY98AR","sessionID":"ses_e893fd3dfffeWSgr5r4RTpxwo0","type":"reasoning","text":"I'm noticing the results are inconsistent now—cases that previously matched bit-exactly, like 1024 with p=4, are now mismatching, which suggests the padding/indirect approach shifted codegen in ways that affect floating-point contraction or vectorization. {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1792995607474,"sessionID":"ses_e893fd3dfffeWSgr5r4RTpxwo0","part":{"id":"prt_176ddae1d0015d5R5b4jd0hirm","messageID":"msg_176dda3ac001Wy14smlEFRnCjZ","sessionID":"ses_e893fd3dfffeWSgr5r4RTpxwo0","type":"reasoning","text":"Adding -ffp-contract=off to the CMake flags gives consistent results across partitions, even though it means the output won't bit-match a default-flags build of the original binary. Since I can't satisfy both determinism and matching the original's default build simultaneously, I'll prioritize deterministic, reproducible results.\n\nMatching the original's exact FMA pattern proved too fragile across tail cases, so I'll settle for -ffp-contract=off with a documented note, since this keeps correctness within floating-point tolerance even if it doesn't bit-match the original build. Next I'll update the CMake configuration, rebuild, rerun the full test suite, and benchmark scalability against the original single-core performance.\n\n","time":{"start":1792995601949,"end":1792995607447},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"signature":""}}}}
